_why: Each edge listed here is used by exactly four triangles: two features that
meet along a LINE instead of overlapping. Manifold emits that faithfully -
two solids touching along a line genuinely cannot be a manifold solid there.
The meshes are still closed, orientable, single-shell and printable.
Sixteen other files were fixed rather than listed, by making the touching
features overlap. See the git history for what moved and why. These four are
in denser code where the offending feature was not obvious on one reading,
so they are recorded with coordinates instead of guessed at.
To fix one: node tools/diagnose-mesh.mjs <slug> prints the bad edges in mm.
Find the feature at those coordinates in <Body> Print Parts.html, give it a
small overlap, then: node tools/reexport.js <slug> <part> && npm run clean-mesh
This is an exact allowlist, not a relaxed rule. Validation fails if a file
not listed here is non-manifold, if a count rises, OR if a count falls - a
fixed part must be removed so the list cannot rot.
_rule: path -> exact number of edges used by more than two triangles
